when.quote: When a customer's savings account interest calculation is incorrect, agents must submit an interest discrepancy report to the backend team for investigation.

starts.note: customer: start only when the customer asks about the interest on one or more savings accounts. Once the records show a discrepancy, the documents tell the agent to credit the interest correction and then submit the report. The agent explains the corrected amount and offers the credit before applying it. Check every savings account the customer names, and correct and report each one separately.
starts.quote: 7) If a discrepancy exists, first apply a credit using apply_savings_account_credit_6831 to correct the customer's account

steps.do: Greet the customer. Ask for their name or email and two of these: date of birth, email, phone number, address. Share no account information yet.
steps.quote: 1) Verify the customer's identity and account ownership

steps.do: Look up the customer's record with what they gave: get_user_information_by_name for a name (case sensitive), get_user_information_by_email for an email, get_user_information_by_id for a user id.

args.customer_name: the name the customer gave (or use get_user_information_by_email / get_user_information_by_id)

steps.quote: 1) Verify the customer's identity and account ownership

steps.do: Check that 2 of DOB, email, phone and address match the record. Reveal nothing before they match. If they do not match, ask again. If they still do not match, say you cannot verify the customer and stop.
steps.quote: 1) Verify the customer's identity and account ownership

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification log.
steps.if: 2 of DOB/email/phone/address matched the record in verify
steps.quote: 1) Verify the customer's identity and account ownership

steps.do: Log the verification with the fields from the verified user's record.

args.name: the verified user's name from the record

steps.if: the customer was verified in verify
steps.quote: 1) Verify the customer's identity and account ownership

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool.
steps.quote: 2) Look up the customer's accounts using get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847

steps.do: Get all of the customer's checking and savings accounts (account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance). Find each savings account in question and every active checking account.
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Get all of the customer's credit card accounts (card type, status) to find which credit card APY bonuses and relationship bonuses could apply.
steps.quote: 4) Review documentation for the savings account type to determine all applicable APY components (base rate, tier rate, linked checking boost, credit card bonuses, relationship bonus)

steps.do: For each account the customer asks about, confirm that it appears in get_accounts, belongs to the verified user and is a savings account. If one does not, tell the customer this procedure covers only their own savings accounts, and do not continue for that account.
steps.quote: 2) Confirm the account is a savings account

steps.do: Compare the accounts and cards the customer mentioned with get_accounts and get_cards. If they differ (for example, a card they do not hold), ask the customer to clarify. Use only the products the records show.
steps.if: the customer's description of their products differs from the records
steps.quote: 1. Identify all checking accounts the customer holds

steps.do: Unlock the transaction history tool.
steps.quote: 3) Check transaction history using get_bank_account_transactions_9173 to find the interest credit

steps.do: For each savings account in question, get its transactions and find the interest_credit for the period in question (the most recent one if the customer did not name a period).

arguments.account_id: each savings account_id in question, from get_accounts

steps.quote: Agents can retrieve the transaction history for a customer's bank account (checking or savings) using the get_bank_account_transactions_9173 tool.

steps.do: For each savings account, list every active checking account from get_accounts. Keep only pairings on the qualifying list, and look up each checking product's documented boost for this savings type. Take the single HIGHEST boost (boosts do not stack). Use 0 if none qualifies.
steps.quote: 2. Determine which checking account provides the highest APY boost for the savings account type

steps.do: For each savings account, look up the credit card APY bonus table in that savings type's own documents. Find the bonus for each active card in get_cards and take the single HIGHEST (card bonuses do not stack). Use 0 if none applies. Also note any relationship bonus that savings type documents, such as a Gold Account with a Gold Rewards Card: +0.025%.
steps.quote: 1. The system identifies all active Rho-Bank credit cards linked to the customer's profile.

steps.do: For each savings account, expected_apy = documented base rate (the tier rate for the balance, if the type has tiers) + the highest checking boost + the highest credit card bonus + any documented relationship bonus. Example for a Gold Account: base 5.5%, Green checking +0.75% beats Purple +0.1%, EcoCard +0.6% is the top card bonus, plus a Gold Rewards relationship bonus of +0.025% if that card is held. If the customer assumed wrong rates, correct them politely from the documents.
steps.quote: 5) Calculate the expected APY by adding all applicable components

steps.do: For each savings account, work out actual_apy from the interest credited and the balance: interest_credit × 12 ÷ balance × 100. Find which checking boost or card bonus the system used, for example a lower checking boost instead of the highest one.
steps.quote: 3. Verify that the system is applying the highest boost, not a lower one

steps.do: For each savings account: expected monthly interest = balance × expected_apy ÷ 100 ÷ 12, rounded to cents. amount_difference = expected monthly interest − interest_credit amount.
steps.quote: 6) Calculate the discrepancy between expected and actual interest

steps.do: If an account's credited interest is not below the expected interest, explain the components that make up its rate. Apply no credit and submit no report for that account.
steps.if: amount_difference for this account is 0 or less
steps.quote: 3) Verify the customer meets one of the eligible circumstances listed above

steps.do: For each account with a shortfall, tell the customer three things: which checking account and credit card should give the boost and bonus (and which lower one the system used); the correct APY; the interest shortfall. Do not reveal internal calculation steps beyond what is needed.
steps.if: amount_difference for this account is greater than 0
steps.quote: 4. If the system selected the wrong checking account, calculate the correct APY and apply an interest correction

steps.do: Offer to credit each account's amount_difference as an interest correction, and to report the issue so it is fixed going forward. Ask whether the customer wants the credits applied.
steps.if: amount_difference for at least one account is greater than 0
steps.quote: 4) Calculate the correct credit amount based on the discrepancy or fee

steps.do: Unlock the savings credit tool once.
steps.if: a discrepancy exists and the customer agrees to the credit
steps.quote: Use the apply_savings_account_credit_6831 tool to add a credit transaction to a savings account.

steps.do: Credit each savings account that has a shortfall with its own amount_difference, as an interest correction. Make one call per account.

arguments.amount: amount_difference for that account from compute_diff

steps.if: amount_difference for that account is greater than 0 and the customer agreed to the credit
steps.quote: 7) If a discrepancy exists, first apply a credit using apply_savings_account_credit_6831 to correct the customer's account

steps.do: Tell the customer each credit amount and the account's new balance.
steps.quote: 6) Inform the customer of the applied credit and new account balance

steps.do: Unlock the discrepancy report tool once.
steps.quote: 8) Then submit the discrepancy report using submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294

steps.do: Submit one interest discrepancy report for each corrected savings account. Submit each one only after that account's credit has gone through.

arguments.expected_apy: expected_apy from compute_expected as a percent number (e.g. 2.775)
arguments.actual_apy: actual_apy from compute_actual as a percent number
arguments.amount_difference: amount_difference for that account from compute_diff

steps.if: a discrepancy exists on that account and its interest_correction credit was applied
steps.quote: Important: Always apply the credit to the customer's account BEFORE submitting the report.

steps.do: Confirm, for every corrected account, the credit applied, the new balance, and that a report was sent to the backend team to fix the calculation going forward.
steps.quote: For interest corrections, after applying the credit, you should also submit an interest discrepancy report using submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294 to ensure the backend team investigates and fixes the underlying issue.

steps.do: If a credit or report call returns an error, tell the customer it could not be completed and ask whether they want a human agent. Transfer only if they agree. If verification failed or an account is not the customer's savings account, do not credit or report it (see verify and confirm_savings).

rules.rule: Checking account boosts do not stack: only the single highest qualifying checking boost applies to a savings account
rules.quote: Only the highest applicable checking account APY boost is applied to the customer's savings account.

rules.rule: If the customer has several checking accounts, only the highest checking boost applies
rules.quote: Only the HIGHEST checking account APY boost is applied to the savings account.

rules.rule: Credit card bonuses do not stack: only the single highest card bonus applies. It does stack with the checking boost.
rules.quote: Only the highest applicable credit card APY bonus is applied to the customer's savings account.

rules.rule: Card bonuses stack with checking boosts, relationship bonuses and tier bonuses
rules.quote: However, credit card APY bonuses DO stack with other types of bonuses, such as:

rules.rule: Only listed checking/savings pairings earn a boost. Examples: Green+Gold, Purple+Gold, Bluest+Bronze, Green Fee-Free+Bronze, Green Fee-Free+Gold Plus, Gold Years+Gold Plus.
rules.quote: Note: Only these specific pairings qualify for the linked checking account APY boost.

rules.rule: A checking account that is not on the pairing list gives no boost to that savings type (for example, Bluest gives no Gold Plus boost, and Gold Years gives no Bronze boost)
rules.quote: Only these specific pairings qualify for the linked checking account APY boost.

rules.rule: Green Account (checking) + Gold Account (savings) is a qualifying pairing

done_when:
All of the following hold:
- The customer is verified and the verification is logged.
- Every savings account the customer asked about has been checked against the documented APY components.
- For each account with a shortfall: if the customer agreed, an interest_correction credit for the difference has been applied with apply_savings_account_credit_6831, followed by a report filed with submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294.
- The customer has been told the correct APY and, for each account, either the credit, the new balance and that the report was filed, or why no correction was due.
- Any failed call has been explained and a transfer offered.
